notes: Tuition for a self-financed non-EU/EEA student is not stated on any supplied page: the programme page only says 'State Scholarships Available' and no fee amount appears, so no tuition fact is output. No application deadline with a year, no start date and no application platform are given for this programme: the admissions.sze.hu pages only show menu items ('Information - Online Application System', 'Admissions step-by-step guide') without naming a route for this programme, so applicationChannel and intakes are omitted. The CEFR B2 levels quoted come from the 'Minimum level of language proficiency (oral)/(written)' fields of the entrance information, not from a sentence about a condition of admission, and the page also names a Cambridge First Certificate; the acceptedTests list contains only tests clearly named (TOEFL, IELTS).

evidence.quote: One of the following indications of English-language proficiency: (a) TOEFL IBT test score of 66, or PBT score 513, (b) Cambridge First Certificate &#34,B&#34,, (c) IELTS score of 5.5
Minimum level of language proficiency (oral): B2 Minimum level of language proficiency (written): B2

note.fr: L'admission comprend un test de langue écrit et un test professionnel écrit sur le background du candidat. Les candidats limites peuvent être invités à un entretien. La date exacte sera annoncée par le secrétariat du programme.
note.en: Admission includes a written language test and a written professional admission test on the applicant's background. Borderline applicants may be invited to an interview. The exact date will be announced by the programme secretary.

evidence.quote: The admission test includes two separate parts: one to check language competence, and another one to check the professional background of the applicant.
The secretary of the programme will notify the candidates about the exact date and time of the admission tests.

note.fr: Le comité d'admission évalue ces critères : formation/expérience antérieure, compétence linguistique, diplôme de fin d'études secondaires et sa mention, recommandations, motivation.
note.en: The admission committee evaluates the following: prior education/experience, language competence, secondary school leaving certificate and its class, recommendations, motivation.

evidence.quote: In its evaluation, the committee considers the following categories: prior education/experience, language competence, secondary school leaving certificate and its class, recommendations, motivation
